Write the whole-module specification

InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rtlpp_02307_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_02307
  (
   input        clk, 
   input        reset,

   output       DALbe_L, 
   output       DALtx, 
   output       DALst, 
   inout [21:0] ZDAL,
   inout        ZBS7,
   inout        ZWTBT,

   input        RSYNC,
   input        RDIN,
   input        RDOUT,
   output       TRPLY,

   input        dma_assert_dal,
   input [21:0] dma_dal,
   input        dma_twtbt, 
   input        dma_dalbe,
   input        dma_daltx,
   input        dma_dalst,

   input        int_assert_vector,

   output [21:0] reg_addr,
   output        reg_bs7,
   output        reg_read_cycle,
   input         reg_addr_match,
   input [15:0]  reg_rdata,
   output [15:0] reg_wdata,
   output        reg_write
   );

   wire [21:0] RDAL = ZDAL;
   wire RBS7 = ZBS7;
   wire RWTBT = ZWTBT;

   reg [21:0] TDAL;
   assign ZDAL = DALtx ? TDAL : 22'bZ;
   assign ZBS7 = DALtx ? 0 : 1'bZ; 
   assign ZWTBT = DALtx ? dma_twtbt : 1'bZ;

   reg [21:0] addr_reg = 0;
   reg bs7_reg = 0;
   reg read_cycle = 0;
   always @(posedge RSYNC) begin
      addr_reg <= RDAL;
      bs7_reg <= RBS7;
      read_cycle <= ~RWTBT;
   end
   assign reg_addr = addr_reg; 
   assign reg_bs7 = bs7_reg;
   assign reg_read_cycle = read_cycle;
   assign reg_wdata = RDAL[15:0];

   reg addr_match = 0;
   reg assert_vector = 0;
   always @(*) begin
      addr_match = 0;
      assert_vector = 0;
      TDAL = 0;

      if (dma_assert_dal)
         TDAL = dma_dal;
      else if (RSYNC) begin
         if (reg_addr_match) begin
            addr_match = 1;
            TDAL = { 6'b0, reg_rdata };
         end else if (int_assert_vector) begin
             assert_vector = 1;
             TDAL = { 6'b0, reg_rdata };
         end
      end
   end

   reg [1:0] addr_match_ra = 0;
   always @(posedge clk) addr_match_ra <= { addr_match_ra[0], addr_match };
   wire saddr_match = addr_match_ra[1];

   reg [3:0] assert_vector_ra = 0;
   always @(posedge clk) assert_vector_ra <= { assert_vector_ra[2:0], assert_vector };
   wire sassert_vector = assert_vector_ra[1];

   reg [2:0] RDOUTra = 0;
   always @(posedge clk) RDOUTra <= { RDOUTra[1:0], RDOUT };
   wire sRDOUT = RDOUTra[1];
   wire sRDOUTpulse = RDOUTra[2:1] == 2'b01;
   assign reg_write = sRDOUTpulse;

   reg [3:0] RDINra = 0;
   always @(posedge clk) RDINra <= { RDINra[2:0], RDIN };
   wire sRDIN = RDINra[1];
   wire sRDINpulse = RDINra[2:1] == 2'b01;

   reg rwDALbe = 0;
   reg rwDALst = 0;
   reg rwDALtx = 0;
   reg rwTRPLY = 0;
   always @(posedge clk) begin
      rwTRPLY <= 0;
      rwDALst <= 0;
      rwDALbe <= 0;
      rwDALtx <= 0;

      if (saddr_match) begin
         if (sRDIN) begin
            rwDALtx <= 1;
            if (RDINra[3]) begin
               rwTRPLY <= 1;
               rwDALbe <= 1;
               rwDALst <= 1;
            end
         end else if (sRDOUT) begin
            rwTRPLY <= 1;
         end
      end else if (sassert_vector) begin
         rwDALtx <= 1;
         if (assert_vector_ra[3]) begin
            rwTRPLY <= 1;
            rwDALbe <= 1;
            rwDALst <= 1;
         end
      end
   end

   assign DALbe_L = ~(rwDALbe | dma_dalbe);
   assign DALst = rwDALst | dma_dalst;
   assign DALtx = rwDALtx | dma_assert_dal;
   assign TRPLY = rwTRPLY;

endmodule
